newsitem.title: USA: Sallie Mae to price floating rate notes.
newsitem.headline: Sallie Mae to price floating rate notes.

text.p: The Student Loan Marketing Association said Friday it will price $400 million of short-term floating rate notes on Monday, May 5.
When-issued trading is expected to begin at 0820 EDT (1220 GMT) the following day, it said.
The notes are for settlement May 8. Maturity date is Nov 20, 1997. Cusip number is 86387TFC7.
Sallie Mae said the notes will be priced at a spread to the bond equivalent rate of the 91-day Treasury bill, with the interest rate reset the day after each weekly T-bill auction.
